text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I train my body, I
can't train
my feelings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't keep making excuses for
myself. I need
to accept my own
weakness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep training! Don't try to
stop me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're probably right... I need to cool
my head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll do as you say, so keep guiding
me
toward victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to slack off or compromise!
My next
race will be one without any
regrets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Also, how are you just as fired up as
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, good. I'm glad we're both
serious
about this!
